Fatou formats and analyzes Julia code without starting Julia. It combines an
opinionated formatter, a configurable linter with automatic fixes, and a
language server that provides completion, hover information, code navigation,
rename, and signature help.

Fatou uses a lossless syntax tree and incremental computation to update its
analysis as you edit. It works from the command line and integrates with editors
through the Language Server Protocol, with extensions for VS Code and Zed. It is
named after Pierre Fatou, whose Fatou set is the complement of the Julia set.
